# F2: Design system and storyboard

**Model:** Opus 5.5, high effort.
**Paste to start:** `Read CLAUDE.md, then docs/build/kickoffs/F2.md, and do F2. Stop for my review at the end.`

## Goal
Set the visual system and one static key frame per scene. This is the design gate: no motion and no scene code. Later scene chats are checked against these frames.

## Inputs
- `docs/build/DESIGN.md`: the type and colour direction, plus the two required variants.
- `docs/build/sketches/*.jpg`: Vali's sketches of the flow.
- `docs/build/research/maidan-map.md`: the map visual language.
- `data/story/*.json` and `data/map/base.json`: the only source of on-screen text and numbers.
- The `roach()` renderer in `index.html` (around line 512). Use it verbatim; don't redraw it.
- Spec sections 5 (visual system) and 6 (scroll budget) only.

## Outputs
- `static/fonts/` + `styles/fonts.css`: self-hosted woff2.
  - Protest Revolution and Public Sans (variable).
  - Noto Sans Devanagari, plus Noto Nastaliq Urdu for the Faiz quote.
- `styles/tokens.css`: palette, type scale, spacing, halftone, roach sizes and z-layers. Two themes: `[data-theme="paper"]` (white-dominant) and `[data-theme="ink"]` (black-dominant).
- `design/board.html`, with:
  - type specimens, including the digits 0–9 and "/" for the S4 skeleton
  - the roach at every size
  - halftone variants
  - the scrubber strip and rail card
  - chart styling, with claimants told apart by pattern
  - quote cards in Latin, Urdu and Devanagari
  - the `*` marker
- `design/storyboard.html`: one key frame per scene at its key `p` values, as a single scrollable page.
- Screenshots of both themes in `design/shots/`.

## Rules
- Every string comes from data. Use `[MISSING: key]` where something is absent.
- Facts with `hold` or `status: "unverified"` are not featured.
- No runtime dependency and no build step.
- UI never covers content.
- Desktop only, minimum viewport 1280×720.

## Done when
- Vali picks a theme and approves the board and storyboard.
- STATUS.md records the chosen theme and any token changes.
